reviews.comment: This professor seems nice but this class was absolutely frustrating. There was almost no homework which is a bonus, but there are online and paper quizzes constantly. Her notes are so disorganized and confusing, mixed with her quiet voice and strong accent it makes lectures totally useless. I had to teach myself nearly everything. Do NOT recommend.

Tests are very similar to her practice problems she provides. Very fair grader and tries to help you earn the grade you deserve. I personally got lost in lectures because I'm not a very theory-based learner, but she was good at walking through the actual problems when she worked them out in class.

Always very willing to help during office hours but her accent and focus on explaining the theory often made it difficult for students and I to grasp concepts well. She is understanding and cares about teaching. Math is a difficult subject - go to HOGU and WIR sessions (very helpful!).

Good understanding of the material but she can not communicate it, the lectures are entirely worthless. I bother to come to class and it's honestly a waste of time. People will say the tests are hard, that's just math, it's an easy A if you're decent at math, but the lectures truly are impossible to learn from. Nice and understanding prof
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Ngl wasn't gonna initially rate her but seeing how much she's getting ripped kinda made me want to put in my 2cts. I thought she was pretty good. Put in a lot of effort to make us understand concepts, and was an okay teacher. Exam 1 was mid, exam 2 was good, exam 3 was awful, final was mid. Just lock in and you'll be fine. Really sweet lady too.
I could never understand the lectures due to her very quiet voice and disorganized notes. I had to teach myself everything which really sucked and made me realize how important having a good prof is.

Tbh, if you just memorize the hw's you can get a B in this class. All her tests are the hws. But don't expect to learn a single thing from her. Very nice lady, but cannot teach at all. 
Also there were supposed to be weekly quizzes but she forgot to give it to us so there were probably 4-5 quizzes the whole semester.

She has an incredibly thick accent, which combined with her mumbling, makes her impossible to understand. Her handwriting is also awful, so you can't learn from her notes either. I had to teach myself from the textbook, which wasn't that helpful because of her extremely long and difficult exams. Do not take this professor, you'll regret it.
Good prof. About average in terms of explaining, but very lenient.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE HER FOR ANY REASON. I am a VERY hard worker and did all the things to do well in the class and was not able to. I'm now protesting my grade. Doesn't answer emails, constantly late to office hours, tests were WAY too hard and long- nothing like practice exams or hw. You will never learn from her lectures. Class is VERY unstructured.
She was okay. Had an accent, bad at explaining things, but lenient and helpful in office hours. Pretty middle of the road. She had some cons, and some pros. Overall the pros made up for the cons.

Surprised by all the good reviews tbh, I heard lots of students griping about her, but I guess they were just a vocal minority. I personally found her to be a competent enough professor. Not as good as, say, Dr. Schrader, but definitely up there. A B was easy to get in the class, and I feel like I could have gotten an A if I worked harder.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Good professor. Only reason I'm writing this review is because I know a lot of students disliked her and I believe it was unfair. Just wanted to voice my satisfaction with her class and teaching. Exams were tough but with preparation, and A was possible. Not too bad, but not too easy.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hard class, good professor. Generous on exams, sweet person, helpful teacher. Would definitely recommend her, despite the bad reviews some gave.
Overall good, not as bad as others make her out to be. 5/5 would take again.

She can be a bit difficult, but tbh, the students who hated her just didn't put enough effort in. I didn't like her at first, but I really put in a lot of effort and went to her office hours and attended each lecture and she grew on me. She's very smart, sweet, and always eager to help. I was able to make an A in the class due to this.

Never take her. She is not a good lecturer and she gave exams that were way too long/hard and did not stick to any of the practice exams or material she posted. She is not good at responding to emails or posting on Canvas. She mumbles and was not understandable in her lectures or office hours. Find another professor.

You won't find too many better in the Math department- that's not to say Dr. Yershova is the best, but rather, that she is the most consistent. I'd rather take a somewhat confusing teacher who is consistent in her grading and curving, than one that oscillates wildly as some of the other teachers do.

All the students who dislike Dr. Yershova are totally warranted- she is not for everyone. Has a thick accent, can stammer, and very little confidence. However, I loved her class and found her likable, as she was very generous on exams and curved, and was extremely sweet- like the sweetest person I've ever met. I also love Math though so that helped

Hard to understand in lecture and notes are often illegible. She would loop around and get confused where she was at during lecture, while speaking very quietly. If you are hoping to learn from the professor and not online resources don't take her. However, if you are the kind of person to learn off youtube videos anyways she'll do the trick.
Good teacher, hard class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Yershova personally. She has an accent, but I didn't mind that. She is very lenient when grading exams and she also curves, but the exams can be challenging. As all others have said, she is very sweet person. Overall, would 100% take again. Student hate seems unjustified- possibly from those that may not have put in enough effort.

Professor Yershova is knowledgeable but hard to follow due to a thick accent, stammer, and indecipherable handwriting. I had to self-learn most concepts as I couldn't understand her lectures. Additionally, 2 of 3 midterms were extremely long, with no one finishing on time. While 251 is easy to self-learn, avoid her if you need clear instruction.

It's CALC 3. It's a hard class, no matter who you take it with. The reason so many students hate Dr. Yershova is because she makes somewhat tough exams sometimes. But, she is also the only teacher to curve the exams when the scores are bad, so it balances out. Overall, her helpful nature and kindness makes the course more pleasant than it could be.
Good enough teacher ig. People who complain about her don't understand how much worse it could be. She is probably on the better end of professors here

Not the hardest math course I've taken, but not the easiest. I'm sure with a better professor, I could've gotten an A, but the thing is, Dr. Yershova is probably one of the best choices for this class because she is sweet, consistent, and tries to make sure your grades don't get hit too hard. After a rough exam, she curved while others didn't.
Pretty good overall, a bit hard though.

The good things about Dr. Yershova are that she is very nice and eager to help and generous with points. The bad is that she has a thick accent, stammers quiet a lot, and gives rather challenging exams. All in all, this class can be a solid B, but you need to work super duper hard for an A. I would gladly take her again.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: extremely unorganized, impossible to understand lecture, definetely self taught, is nice but overall not worth it.

Pros- Extremely sweet, lenient on exams, willing to put in time to help.
Cons- Unorganized, tests can be difficult, accent.
I would love to take Dr. Ershova's class again, I thought she was a pretty good professor overall. Definitely not the best I've had, but pretty consistent and very nice. I liked her class a lot, but I get that it's not for all

Dr. Yershova's class is not easy, as she has a thick accent and is difficult to understand at times, and her class consists largely of exams. However, she is very pardoning on these exams, and is very sweet, probably one of the kindest people I've met bar none. In addition, she is always willing to put in extra time to grasp material

I enjoyed her class very much, one of the best Math professors I've ever had. Very sweet lady, and she was always willing to spend as much time necessary to help during office hours. I really hope she stays at A&M for long enough for me to take a more advanced class with her.
Awesome lecturer, and very kind lady as well. Really enjoyed her class and found it so interesting. Take her!

I loved Dr. Yershova's class. She had a thick accent, but was extremely pardoning when it came to Exams. She's very smart, and so she often overestimates the student's abilities and makes the exams too long. Dr. Yershova is very nice and helpful in office hours though, and her notes are pretty useful. Hope I'll be able to take her class again.

She's a nice person but you can barely understand her, and I don't think she understands the concept of writing exams that are able to be completed within the allotted time. Theres an issue if the professor from the class 20 minutes after has to kick us out because the majority of the class isn't done with the exam. Do not take her if possible.

She is a really kind and caring professor; however, she is near impossible to understand for many kids unfamiliar with thick accents. I was able to understand with it, but when some people don't understand they ask redundant questions and it makes the class unbearable. Grades easy and is helpful, so if you can teach yourself, its a free A.

She is hard to understand, and frequently stutters while trying to explain concepts while lecturing. Her lectures seemed very unorganized and she often times forgets to upload notes pages to Canvas, which makes it even harder to focus on learning the material while trying to copy down everything she writes (which seems like rambling mostly).
lectures are unorganized and very hard to understand. they are very messy on canvas. be prepared to teach yourself calc 3, but the exams are pretty similar to the test reviews.

The class itself is easy and she's very generous when it comes to quizzes and tests as she tells you what's going to be on it and what to practice. However, going to class is a necessity as she does not use canvas to announce quiz dates and they're sporadic. Her lectures are a bit hard to understand, but she doesn't deviate from the textbook.

Dr. Yershova is extremely kind and caring. Despite this, her lectures are poorly organized. Expect pop quizzes! You will end up teaching most of the content to yourself, but she is readily accessible outside of class and allows you to ask questions on exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof Yershova is one of the sweetest people I have ever met, but be prepared to teach yourself differential equations. Homework is straight from the book and she basically goes over what's going to be on the exams. She even lets students ask her for help during exams if they get stuck. BUT her lectures are really difficult to follow so be warned.
Hard to understand, not clear on what is expected. Nice lady, went to a few office hours. Not too hard once you get her style down. (IM MATH 308,Diff. EQ)

Her midterms were graded very leniently, the questions were nearly identical to her exam reviews, she allowed calculators on tests, and she even allowed students to ask for help during them. That being said, quizzes and homework were irregular, and her teaching was just writing on a board and also doesn't keep track of assignments on Canvus.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She did not follow her syllabus about quizzes and homework. Lectures focused more on proofs than the math but exams only covered the math. Her practice exams were identical to her actual exams.
